summary: Distinguish Fourier populations from localization and calculate a separate real-circle causal response without deriving a compact UBT kinetic term.

stage_events.description: The author requested continuation of the existing hyperspace-wave/UBT derivation, with earlier authorization to correct and merge related project work. This is task direction, not approval of a new physical result.

Derive the interval concentration matrix and diagonal-population obstruction. In an explicitly postulated real-circle reduced-mode comparator, compute contact/periodic responses, resonance subtraction and the causal image kernel.

Independently compare continuous wavefunction integrals, source/readout convolution, image/Fourier sums, differential and jump identities, and the retarded Laplace transform. Record finite-mode artifacts as counterexamples, not physical faster signals.

Keep imaginary time distinct from an independent real compact coordinate, coherent amplitudes distinct from occupations, harmonic counts distinct from Theta components, and the separate linear comparator distinct from composite or produced-pair transport.
